name: 80138 · Parker, CO
findings: ZIP 80138 (Parker) has 119 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80138 (Parker) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
